name: Invoicefacts Sales segment selects issotrx doctypes only, tenant-scoped
note: Segment coverage. Segments compare the RAW column produced by the cube SQL, not the dimension, so a cube whose CASE lives in the dimension instead of the SQL has segments that silently match nothing - which is exactly what had happened to Orderfacts.Sales (0 rows vs 86,370). This cube keeps its CASE in the SQL so the segment works today; the case exists so that removing the CASE - the natural boolean cleanup, since type: boolean converts 'Y'/'N' unaided - cannot break it unnoticed. Measure-level cases would all stay green. Note issotrx here comes from c_doctype (dt.issotrx), not from the invoice.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_invoice i JOIN c_invoiceline il ON il.c_invoice_id=i.c_invoice_id JOIN c_doctype dt ON i.c_doctype_id=dt.c_doctype_id WHERE i.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND i.dateinvoiced >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.dateinvoiced < DATE '2026-09-01'
